5be0509bed4e1be9b75865bd92bcd9d3c22666cc.pinyin: wàn yī yǒu jǐn jí qíng kuàng, lián xì wǒ de dài lǐ rén.
5be0509bed4e1be9b75865bd92bcd9d3c22666cc.text: 万一有紧急情况，联系我的代理人。

5be0568d8e8d865e6684ba38015b37ec0d290c40.pinyin: lǎo shī ràng wǒ men xiān quān chū bú rèn shi de zì cí.
5be0568d8e8d865e6684ba38015b37ec0d290c40.text: 老师让我们先圈出不认识的字词。

5be1ae314e2c443b39c53a428f2b282f65ccca20.pinyin: chuán lí kāi gǎng kǒu hòu, sì zhōu zhǐ shèng yí wàng wú yín de hǎi miàn.
5be1ae314e2c443b39c53a428f2b282f65ccca20.text: 船离开港口后，四周只剩一望无垠的海面。

5be413248cde204e55a9945c3c29176e9708a6f1.pinyin: ràng wǒ men zài jù zài yī qǐ!

5be4e0fa963fd3fbf2ea6b9652bf09ff1b0d394c.pinyin: hái zǐ bǎ xǐ shǒu yè dāng yán liào, nòng de mā mā kū xiào bù dé.
5be4e0fa963fd3fbf2ea6b9652bf09ff1b0d394c.text: 孩子把洗手液当颜料，弄得妈妈哭笑不得。
5be4e0fa963fd3fbf2ea6b9652bf09ff1b0d394c.unsupportedReason: ToneSandhi cannot uniquely bind this repeated text to its recorded reading

5be62851ae6252cbb4b545ab5f487231304cbb7c.pinyin: jī lěi de yì jiàn ràng tā bù tǔ bù kuài.
5be62851ae6252cbb4b545ab5f487231304cbb7c.text: 积累的意见让她不吐不快。

5be855914d5fb4649bac7aa3865abf03f5b5e98a.pinyin: xǐ shǒu shí kě yǐ yòng yì diǎn xǐ shǒu yè.
5be855914d5fb4649bac7aa3865abf03f5b5e98a.text: 洗手时可以用一点洗手液。

5bed4ec7c5822c02ab37d3c20ded95a35b3ed83f.pinyin: bù guò shì yī ge wén zì yóu xì bà liǎo.
5bed4ec7c5822c02ab37d3c20ded95a35b3ed83f.text: 不过是一个文字游戏罢了。

5bf0a3b8efec78a8f442983832e8227e72d39d19.pinyin: duō nián de jī lěi ràng tā hòu jī bó fā.
5bf0a3b8efec78a8f442983832e8227e72d39d19.text: 多年的积累让她厚积薄发。

5bf63fdae1458b61968701c64563d26d8692fb5a.pinyin: wǒ bǎ wù gǎi de shè zhì huán yuán le.
5bf63fdae1458b61968701c64563d26d8692fb5a.text: 我把误改的设置还原了。

5bf992f457fc3775f9867bcbba99ad60aa9abec8.pinyin: zhè shǒu shī de yīn yùn hěn měi.

5bfb1f1bb9288d3ddf9f7801377dc162a965643d.pinyin: jú shì jǐn zhāng, shǒu jūn zhěn gē dài dàn.
5bfb1f1bb9288d3ddf9f7801377dc162a965643d.text: 局势紧张，守军枕戈待旦。

5bfda593c02cebd6d80c82e85c34442a7f0f2a71.pinyin: zhuō shàng fàng zhe yī dié chǎo fěi zi.
